description: Normalize source and target observations before comparing them.

rules.note: Trailing spaces/tabs are not part of the contract.
Repeated blank lines collapse to a single blank line.
Human-readable message comparisons collapse runs of whitespace and newlines; messages are never matched whole.
Integers and floats that denote the same value compare equal (50 == 50.0).
Shell completion script bodies are compared for existence and shell markers only, never character-for-character.
Errors compare by exit code / error kind first; message text only after whitespace normalization and containment.
